command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline boot id =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "== baseline sysctl values =="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects 2>/dev/null || true
echo "== STEP: writing persistent sysctl config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
echo "== STEP: applying =="
sudo -n sysctl --system
echo "== STEP: verifying live values =="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route \
  net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects
echo "DONE"
